description: This file contains test cases for functions that convert CSV lines into diff and commit data structures, aggregate diff data over time, and determine the technology area of authors. It primarily focuses on testing the functionality of parsing and data transformation within the mappers module.

methods.name: TestCSVLineToDiffRow
methods.description: Test for converting a CSV line into a DiffRow structure, verifying correct parsing.

methods.name: TestCSVLineToCommitRow
methods.description: Test for converting a CSV line into a CommitRow structure, verifying correct parsing.

methods.name: TestDiffRowsToAggregateChangesOverTime
methods.description: Test for aggregating diff rows over time into a summarized form.

methods.name: makeDiffRow
methods.description: Helper function to create an AnalyzedDiffRow with specified parameters for testing.

methods.name: TestGetAuthorTechAreaUnknown
methods.description: Test for determining an author's tech area when the author is not recognized.

methods.name: TestGetAuthorTechAreaKnown
methods.description: Test for determining an author's tech area when the author is recognized as part of the Build team.
